name: Space Goblin (Goblin Variant)
body:
Space-based goblins tend to be quite a bit more shrewd than those who run amok planet-side. Although still bundles of chaotic energy, many learn useful skills and put them to work aboard starships and space stations. However, a goblin’s idea of what it takes to make a machine run properly is often at odds with standard operating procedure, giving them a reputation as unreliable starship crew members.

Clever Your ability score modifiers are +2 Dex, +2 Int, –2 Cha. This feature and the tinker feature replace the standard goblin ability score modifiers.
Integrated You begin play speaking Common and Goblin. If you have a high Intelligence score, you can choose from any of the following languages: Draconic, Dwarven, Halfling, Orc, Vesk, and Ysoki. This alters languages.
Scrounger You are well-adapted to living life on the edge. You receive a +2 species bonus to Disable Device, Stealth, and Survival checks. This trait replaces skilled.
Tinker (Ex) You clever and are skilled at getting the most out of broken equipment. As a move action, you can remove the penalties associated with the broken condition from a single piece of equipment until the start of your next turn. The item then becomes unusable for 10 minutes, and retains the broken condition after that until it is fixed.
